📋 Exam Pattern
Prelims Exam Pattern

  Duration: 1 hour
  Sections: English Language (30 marks, 20 mins), Numerical Ability (35 marks, 20 mins), Reasoning Ability (35 marks, 20 mins)
  Total Marks: 100
  Negative Marking: 0.25 marks for each wrong answer

Mains Exam Pattern

  Duration: 2 hours 40 minutes
  Sections: General/Financial Awareness (50 marks, 35 mins), General English (40 marks, 35 mins), Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude (60 marks, 45 mins), Quantitative Aptitude (50 marks, 45 mins)
  Total Marks: 200
  Negative Marking: 0.25 marks for each wrong answer




📚 Syllabus
Prelims Syllabus

  English Language: Reading Comprehension, Cloze Test, Para Jumbles, Error Detection
  Numerical Ability: Simplification, Number Series, Data Interpretation, Quadratic Equations
  Reasoning Ability: Puzzles, Seating Arrangement, Syllogism, Blood Relations

Mains Syllabus

  General/Financial Awareness: Current Affairs, Banking Awareness, Financial News
  General English: Reading Comprehension, Sentence Improvement, Para Completion
  Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude: Logical Reasoning, Data Sufficiency, Basic Computer Knowledge
  Quantitative Aptitude: Data Interpretation, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Probability
